title: Rhythm and meter
summary: How long notes last and how beats are grouped.

lessons.title: Note values and time signatures
lessons.summary: Whole, half, quarter, eighth, and what the two numbers mean.

blocks.text: Each note value lasts half as long as the one before: a whole note equals two half notes, a half note equals two quarter notes, a quarter note equals two eighth notes, and an eighth equals two sixteenths.
A dot after a note adds half of its length again. A dotted half note lasts three quarter notes; a dotted quarter lasts three eighths.

A time signature has two numbers. The top number says how many beats are in each measure. The bottom number says which note value gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note. So 3/4 means three quarter-note beats in each measure.

exercise.prompt: How many quarter notes last as long as one dotted half note?
exercise.explanation: A half note is two quarters, and the dot adds half again: three.

exercise.prompt: In 4/4 time, how many eighth notes fill one measure?
exercise.explanation: Four quarter-note beats, two eighths in each: eight.

exercise.prompt: A piece is in 3/4. Which of these fills exactly one measure?
exercise.explanation: Three quarter beats equal one dotted half note.

blocks.text: Some tunes begin before the first full measure. Those opening notes are called a pickup, and the last measure of the piece is shortened to make up for them.
Amazing Grace is in 3/4 and starts with a one-beat pickup.

lessons.title: Six-eight time
lessons.summary: Two big beats, each divided in three.

blocks.text: In 6/8 there are six eighth notes in a measure, but they are felt in two groups of three. You count two beats per measure, and each beat is a dotted quarter note.
That grouping is what separates 6/8 from 3/4. Both hold six eighth notes, but 3/4 has three beats divided in two, and 6/8 has two beats divided in three.

exercise.prompt: How many main beats do you feel in a measure of 6/8?
exercise.explanation: Two dotted-quarter beats, each made of three eighths.

exercise.prompt: Which note gets one main beat in 6/8?
exercise.explanation: Three eighths make a dotted quarter.

blocks.text: Greensleeves is in 6/8: listen for long–short, long–short in each beat.
